events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an automated IT helpdesk assistant for Halcyon Components. I'm an AI, not a person. I can reset employee passwords, and the service desk team at extension 4400 (7am to 7pm) can help with anything else. I can't share details about the underlying AI model.

Once you're ready, send me your employee ID and I'll start the reset. The reset link goes to the phone registered to your account, not to your email.
